wins: Maintained high average reward of 97.5 by successfully navigating reconnaissance and initial exploitation phases.
Consistently identified exposed HTTP service and gathered service banners rapidly to inform follow-up actions.
fails: Despite high reward, achieved 0% success due to inability to execute post-exploitation or capture the final objective.
Relied too heavily on manual mentor guidance (15 calls) without automating repeatable exploit actions.
key_outcomes.summary: Strong reconnaissance performance produced high reward, but the run failed to complete the objective due to lack of automated exploitation chaining and excessive mentor dependency.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Failed to escalate privileges after initial access despite confirming valid credentials/utilities (e.g., no lateral movement execution).

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80/443 is confirmed open and HTTP banner contains identifiable web application version
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted gobuster directory enumeration and nikto scan

skill_cards.if_condition: When POST endpoints accept user input and responses vary with payload content
skill_cards.then_action: Execute sqlmap with identified target and enumerate available databases/tables

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in quickly enumerating web services and guiding follow-up scans.
